h: Eight Zamfara lawmakers reportedly return to the APC, with Matawalle praised for the move
p: Eight lawmakers in Zamfara State have reportedly rejoined the ruling APC, with supporters of Bello Matawalle crediting him for the return. The development comes as parties reshuffle their ranks ahead of the 2027 elections. Opposition figures have not yet commented.
more: Defections and returns are increasing as 2027 campaigns gather pace.
Supporters hailed the move as a boost for the APC in the north-west.
It is not yet clear which parties the lawmakers had been with.
